title: Mobile Sample
description: An interactive baseline walkthrough of the six high-level steps for taking a Mission Surface prototype from starter download to Request dashboard feedback.
limitations: GitHub connection, publishing, comments, and feedback submission are simulated
No files are downloaded and no changes are persisted

items.title: Progress Measured
items.content: Each step contributes to overall progress, with completion reaching 100% once all steps are finished.

Step 1 : Prototype Starter
The user must download the zip file to progress to the next step in the workflow.

Step 3: Repository Connection
The user must connect their new github prototypes repository with starter to enable prototypes.

Step 3 : Two prototype options
The user can provide two types of prototypes 1) images created in the repository or 2) live via github pages.

Step 4 : Verify
Mission Surface will verify the setup before making prototypes available to review.
Evaluate whether review tools and contextual commenting feel connected to the demonstrated journey.
Evaluate whether the handoff from prototype review to the Request dashboard closes the feedback loop.
